status: WIP: measured isolated prepared-execution improvement; not a sysbench/TPC-C throughput claim or whole-package completion.
change: FieldType and CollationInfo share immutable charset/collation bytes through Arc<str>, matching Go's string-header copies. Setters replace only their own handle; exact spellings, hashes, serialization and ENUM/SET sharing remain unchanged.
worktree: Both binaries include the same pre-existing dirty shared worktree; only this increment's three production files differ.

measurement.scope: Single Session, in-process storage, four rows; current prepared bind/execute entry, no network or live service. One hundred warmups; five rounds of 10000 operations per case, two invocations per binary.
measurement.acceptance: Use only c/d runs, after builds, tests and profiles completed. Earlier a/b runs overlapped compilation and are excluded. Exact result lines match across all four retained runs. Point control is too short to support a separate speedup claim.

validation.qualification: The seven prior topics have byte-identical normalized reports including 67 divergence details. The four added topics have 42 divergences; no exact pre-change replay was saved for those topics, so they are not classified as new or unchanged.

profiling.interpretation: FieldType drop-glue inclusive sample count in the executor specialization fell from 341 to 41. Equal-duration samples execute different numbers of operations; these are causal diagnostics, not per-operation time or throughput.

reproduction.initial_lockfile: The new temporary standalone workspace generated its Cargo.lock with an offline release -j12 build; subsequent builds used --locked.
source: for sql in ["create database probe", "use probe",
"create table t (id bigint primary key, k bigint, v varchar(40), key ik(k))",
("point", "select v from t where id=?", vec![Datum::Int(2)]),
("range", "select v from t where id between ? and ?", vec![Datum::Int(1),Datum::Int(3)]),
("index", "select v from t where k between ? and ?", vec![Datum::Int(11),Datum::Int(13)]),
("aggregate", "select sum(k) from t where id between ? and ?", vec![Datum::Int(1),Datum::Int(3)]),
("sort", "select v from t where id between ? and ? order by k", vec![Datum::Int(1),Datum::Int(3)]),
